rowA.text: Direction A — indigo band, light workspace, amber accent

legend.text: All example content mirrors the deterministic fixtures (project “fixture”, task “Three modules”, items a/b/c, built-in roles). Counts and stages are real backend fields; nothing shows percentages, estimates or model availability that the backend cannot measure. Controls that arrive in U2/U3 are drawn visibly unavailable.

chosen.text: Selected direction: A, with a denser two-column Overview.

rowU3.text: U3 — browser workflows and guided setup (extends Direction A; U1/U2 boards unchanged)

legendU3.text: U3 contracts drawn here: POST /projects with strict ProjectInput and preserved input on failure; one idempotency key per submission attempt, held until the outcome is known; mode/approve/cancel reuse the existing routes and bind to the displayed task version; the diff is read by task identity only, text-only, with unavailable/binary/truncated/empty told apart; setup reuses the terminal flow and never collects credentials or runs a paid test on its own.
